implemented_local_contract: Unknown or incomplete cleanup owner collection returns an error and no decisions.
ObservedAt must equal the supplied alert snapshot clock.
Every owner must have nonnegative age, positive immutable deadline, and an explicitly known residual-volume fact.
All owners are validated, including invalid owners after an already-overdue one.
Only age strictly greater than that same owner immutable deadline fires either critical.
A confirmed complete empty collection is healthy; absent collection is not an empty result.
required_collector_invariants: Read the complete installation-scoped authoritative owner/resource set in one bounded read-only consistent transaction, with one UTC database clock.
Check every row, result-set error, cancellation, read limit and transaction end; overflow or partial data cannot set Complete.
Preserve the exact frozen owner budget and original start anchor; never replace them with active_config, updated_at, a heartbeat or claim reacquisition.
Bind origin, operation_type, target and resource relationship explicitly; the existing cleanup_operation_id foreign key to operations.id alone does not prove those bindings.

For an explicit cleanup operation use its reviewed immutable creation/deadline facts only after the complete owner/target binding is established. Do not join cleanup via result_config_version, whose defined use is config_update.

Automatic cleanup owners require an original reviewed durable linearization-time mapping. finished_at is only a candidate for the specific success-to-pending atomic transition, not a general cleanup start.
Residual-volume classification and authoritative residual presence must be known; nil cannot become false by default.
Populate Complete only after the full read and all validations succeed; this flag grants no SQL authority, readiness, admission or production permission.

remaining_owner_inputs.decision: Approve automatic backup staging/drill cleanup start and immutable budget provenance, and the precise resource/operation binding; do not invent a SQL column or timestamp mapping.
Implement and review the bounded authoritative collector/read integration once the original time and config mappings are fixed.
For four singleton gate/hold rules project the same active gate frozen timeout/hold values and matching labels; active system configuration is not a substitute.

production_evaluator.required: Select and validate actual PromQL/controller-state evaluator, no-data, counter reset, recovery and notification dedupe behavior.
